1. Why Legacy T+1 CDP & Raw NL2SQL Fail in Omnichannel Retail
Solving Fragmented Profiles, Phantom Inventory Overselling, and +14.2% Net-Margin Hallucination
⛔ Legacy Siloed CDP + Batch DWH + Raw-Table Chatbot (T+1 Lag · Overselling · Margin Drift)
• T+1 Batch CDP Lag: App clickstream (BigQuery), CRM (Salesforce) & store POS sync overnight — misses 3-min in-store conversion window
• Phantom Inventory: E-commerce & store POS cache inventory separately -> 4.8% flash-sale stockout cancellations while nearby stores overstock
• Raw Table NL2SQL Drift: Store bots query uncurated order tables without DAX return/promo rules -> +14.2% net-margin error (DL-23)
• Per-Seat BI + Streaming Tax: Paying per-GB ingestion + $20-$50/seat BI licenses for 9,600 store associates ($309.0K/mo stitched TCO)
✅ Microsoft Fabric Omnichannel Customer 360 + Clienteling Agent (46ms E2E · 0.0% Drift · $0 Viewer Seat)

BigQuery GA4 Mirroring (GA)
+ Salesforce Shortcut ($0 ETL)

995K EPS POS/RFID + App Stream
0.00% Phantom Stockout ($0/GB)

2. Five-Cloud Retail Platform Selection & Coexistence Boundaries
Clear Decision Boundaries for Cloud & AI Solution Architects (Mainstream Retail & CPG Enterprises)
① Microsoft Fabric (OneLake + Eventhouse + Retail Data Solutions + Data Agent + DirectLake)
Best for: End-to-end omnichannel Customer 360, sub-second store POS/RFID ATP, 1,000+ store associates asking in Teams ($0 viewer seat),
and write-back of inter-store transfers & personalized coupons via Power BI Agentic App (1GB Free Fabric SQL).
② Databricks (Lakeflow / DLT + Photon + Mosaic AI Feature & Model Serving)
Best for: Data science teams training custom deep-learning recommendation models (Two-Tower / DLRM) on PB-scale clickstreams.
Coexistence: Train embeddings in Databricks GPU -> Zero-copy Delta to OneLake -> Serve 9,600 store staff via Fabric DirectLake & Teams.
③ Snowflake (Retail Data Cloud + Data Clean Rooms + Cortex Analyst/Search)
Best for: Standardized SQL enterprise EDW & B2B Retail Media Network (RMN) privacy clean rooms with external CPG brands.
Coexistence: Keep RMN Clean Room in Snowflake -> OneLake Snowflake Mirroring ($0 compute) + Apache Ossie YAML to Fabric IQ.
④ Google BigQuery + Vertex AI Retail
Native GA4 / Google Ads attribution & e-commerce search; zero-ETL into Fabric via BigQuery Mirroring (GA).
⑤ AWS (S3 Tables + Personalize + Redshift)
AWS-native microservices & turn-key Personalize API; mount S3 logs via OneLake S3 Shortcuts (28ms cache).
💡 Architect Golden Rule: Never Rip-and-Replace Existing GA4 (BigQuery) or CRM (Salesforce) Stores!
Use OneLake Mirroring + Shortcuts to unify multi-cloud customer signals in place, and put Fabric IQ Ontology + Teams Clienteling on top.
